schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: pnpm installs nothing younger than 14 days (web/pnpm-workspace.yaml), so neither may Renovate
npm dependencies: minor and patch updates in one PR, majors one by one
npm dev dependencies: minor and patch updates in one PR, merged automatically once CI is green
Docker base images (Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml): minor and patch updates in one PR
The Go toolchain moves together: go.mod's go and toolchain lines and the golang build image
A new PostgreSQL major needs a dump and restore of existing data (docs/operations.md); upgrade it by hand
The receipt renderer (tools/receipt-pdf) is built reproducibly with pinned Rust and typst versions and its sha256 is checked in CI (ADR 0012); update it by hand with `just typst-wasm`
